## Summary

Describe the problem and the implemented solution.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Infrastructure or CI
- [ ] Model or data change

## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests pass
- [ ] Frontend lint and build pass
- [ ] Relevant browser/integration tests pass
- [ ] No secrets, generated data, databases, or logs are included
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` were updated when required

## ML/RAG impact

List affected model versions, feature schemas, corpus documents, evaluation results, or write `None`.

## Screenshots or API evidence

Add evidence for user-visible or contract changes.
